blockingIssues.description: Unable to execute required review subagent for this feature. Task launches repeatedly failed in this validator session (initially `Invalid model: custom:GPT-5.3-codex`, then no assistant-message events even after temporary reviewer-model overrides), so no review report could be generated.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an explicit scrutiny fallback policy for subagent infrastructure failure (for example: when Task launches fail after model troubleshooting, whether validator should perform an in-process review fallback or fail-fast).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: This validator run completed all core validators but could not spawn any review subagent due Task launch failures, leaving no canonical path in guidance for proceeding.
